detailed_descriptions.en: THE ULTIMATE RAILWAY HOBBY The ultimate railway hobby for more than 15 years! From historic steam locomotives to modern high-speed and heavy freight trains, and routes around the world, Train Simulator Classic is the simulation made by railfans for railfans. A WORLD OF RAILWAYS Train Simulator Classic takes you to three countries, with more than 400km/250 miles of detailed real-world routes included. Drive heavy freight trains on the USA’s challenging Saluda Grade, move passengers and freight along Germany’s historic Hochrheinbahn, and take passengers from the English Channel ports towns of Dover and Ramsgate to the capital city, London. LICENSED TRAINS Take the controls of trains which are officially licensed by the operating companies. Drive variations of Southeastern’s Class 465, 375 and 395 on Chatham Main Line, take Deutsche Bahn’s BR111 and BR189 from Konstanz to Villingen, and negotiate Saluda Grade in Norfolk Southern’s EMD SD40-2s and GP35s. Get to grips with realistic signalling systems, authentic brake controls and lifelike weather conditions as you become an expert driver through 25 career-mode scenarios, or use Quick Drive to drive the trains you like, wherever you like. BUILD AND REBUILD Use the Train Simulator Editor to build living worlds with comprehensive tools. Create your own dream railway or scenario and start a service with your favourite locomotive. With full Steam Workshop support you can share your creations with other railfans around the world, or browse through the thousands of community creations already available to try out. Please Note: The Train Simulator interface is localised into English, French, German, Italian, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Spanish. Localisation on locos and route content varies depending on the developer who created it. KEY FEATURES Hundreds of kilometres of track in lifelike real-world locations Licensed trains and rolling stock 25 Career scenarios with varied rail experiences, plus Quick Drive 3 stunningly recreated real-world railway routes with stations, freight yards and more BR Class 465/9 in Southeastern Blue Stripe & Grey Stripe liveries BR Class 465/0 and 465/1 in Southeastern Blue Stripe & Grey Stripe liveries BR Class 395 in Southeastern Highspeed original & 10th Anniversary liveries BR Class 375/3, 375/6, 375/7, 375/8 and 375/9 in a variety of Southeastern liveries BR Class 377/1 in Southern livery (with Southern and Southeastern Logos) BR Class 377/5 in Southeastern livery DB BR189 in Traffic Red livery DB BR111 in Traffic Red livery DB DABz Dost and ABn Regio coaches and a selection of freight wagons Norfolk Southern (ex-Southern) high-hood EMD SD40-2 Norfolk Southern (ex-Norfolk & Western) low-nose EMD SD40-2 Norfolk Southern (ex-Southern) high-nose EMD GP35 A selection of Norfolk Southern freight wagons Realistic signalling, safety systems and locomotive controls Train Simulator Editor creative tool Full Steam Workshop support
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 终极铁路爱好 15 余年来的终极铁路爱好！从经典的蒸汽机车到现代的高速列车与重载货运列车，以及世界各地的铁路线路，《经典模拟列车》是铁道迷为同好们制作的模拟游戏。 铁路的世界 《经典模拟列车》将带你遨游三个国家，在细节详尽，长度超过 400 公里/250 英里的真实铁路线上飞驰。你将在挑战性十足的美国萨卢达坡道上驾驶重载货运列车，在历史悠久的德国上莱茵铁路上运送乘客和货物，或是将乘客从英吉利海峡畔的港口城市多佛和拉姆斯盖特送往首都伦敦。 授权列车 操控获得运营公司授权的各式列车。驾驶东南铁路公司的 465 型动车组、375 型动车组和 395 型动车组在查塔姆主线上飞驰，驾驶德国铁路的德铁 111 型电力机车和德铁 189 型电力机车从康斯坦茨一路驶往菲林根，或是操纵诺福克南方铁路公司旗下的易安迪 SD40-2s 型柴油机车和 GP35s 型柴油机车通过陡峭的萨卢达坡道。在 25 个职业模式场景中成为专家级火车司机，掌握拟真的信号系统、真实的制动控制和逼真的天气条件，或者使用快速驾驶在任意线路上驾驶你最喜爱的列车。 建造与再建造 使用功能强大的模拟列车编辑器打造属于你的火车世界。创造只属于你的铁路或场景，驾驶你最爱的机车提供列车班次服务。编辑器完全支持 Steam 创意工坊，你可以与世界各地的其他铁路爱好者分享你的作品，或浏览并尝试已有的数以千计的社区作品。 请注意：“模拟列车”系列现已支持英语、法语、德语、意大利语、波兰语、俄语、简体中文和西班牙语用户界面。机车和线路内容的本地化情况将因其开发商的不同而有所差异。 主要亮点 逼真的真实世界场景中的数百公里铁路轨道 得到授权的列车和客货车厢 25 个职业场景，提供丰富多彩的铁路体验，同时还有快速驾驶模式 3 条令人惊叹的、经过精细重现的真实铁路线，包含车站、货运站场等设施 东南铁路公司蓝色条纹涂装和灰色条纹涂装的英铁 465/9 型动车组 拥有东南铁路公司蓝色条纹涂装和灰色条纹涂装的英铁 465/0 型和 465/1 型动车组 拥有东南铁路公司高铁原版涂装和十周年纪念涂装的英铁 395 型动车组 拥有各式东南铁路涂装的英铁 375/3 型、375/6 型、375/7 型、375/8 型和 375/9 型动车组 拥有南方铁路涂装的英铁 377/1 型动车组（带有南方铁路和东南铁路标志） 拥有东南铁路涂装的英铁 377/5 型动车组 拥有德铁红色涂装的德铁 189 型机车 拥有德铁红色涂装的德铁 111 型机车 德铁 DABz 型双层客车厢以及 ABn 型区域列车客车厢，此外还有一系列货车厢 诺福克南方铁路公司（前南方铁路公司）易安迪 SD40-2 高顶型机车 诺福克南方铁路公司（前诺福克及西方铁路公司）易安迪 SD40-2 低鼻型机车 诺福克南方铁路公司（前南方铁路公司）易安迪 GP35 型高鼻型机车 诺福克南方铁路公司旗下的各式货运车厢 真实的信号传输、安全系统与机车控制 模拟列车编辑器创作工具 完全支持 Steam 创意工坊
